services.desc: Step into the Spotlight at Broadway Palm Bootcamp! Campers don’t just put on a show, they build confidence, learn to work as a team, and become responsible rockstars. No experience? No problem! These camps are designed to build self-esteem as students refine their creativity, active listening, and concentration skills all while learning about musical theatre. Take a journey into the swamp with Shrek, Donkey, Fiona, Dragon, and all your favorite fairy-tale characters! Shrek Jr. gave Broadway Palm Bootcamp performers the chance to explore fun, memorable roles while discovering thee importance of friendship, confidence, and being true to yourself.
